name: equipo
description: Parallel agents, each in its own worktree (with Orca or plain git): merges into the main branch with a dry run and a queue, a context bar, git guards and the skills of the workflow. In English and Spanish.

contexto.title: Context bar
contexto.description: A line above the prompt with the context used and free, and a Compact button.

subidas.title: Merges from the main copy
subidas.description: Branches their agents hand back show above the prompt with Merge, Fix and Dismiss; dry run, queue and the batch check.

fusiones.title: Merge guard
fusiones.description: From a worktree, refuses merging into the main copy: branches are merged by the user from there.

commits.title: Commit guard
commits.description: In the main copy, refuses git add -A / . / -u and git commit -a; in any copy, the files listed in "prohibidos" in .claude/equipo.json.
